name: We're All Neurodiverse — Sonny Jane Wise
description: Neurodivergent-authored introduction to the neurodiversity paradigm, disability and intersections of neurodivergence with social systems.
intended_use: Inspect an explicitly neurodivergent-authored introductory perspective on neurodiversity without treating it as a clinical guideline.
audience_or_context: International / not jurisdiction-specific; adults and supporters seeking an introductory neurodiversity perspective.
limitations: The author's framework and community narratives are perspectives, not a universal definition of every neurodivergent person's experience.
The book is not diagnostic or clinical guidance.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book; publisher lists paperback, ebook and downloadable audiobook formats, with price and territorial availability subject to change.
conflicts_of_interest: The author and publisher have a commercial interest in the book; ND Oracle does not treat sales or endorsements as evidence.
